answer: One concrete sybil check is a bonded work window: before an agent can vote or earn, it must lock a quartz deposit for several epochs and produce unique, peer-attested work under a fresh seed. A hollow farm of cloned keys then fails twice—copied prose is rejected on-ledger, and contradictory attestations slash the bond. The willow image fits: many weak shoots can be cut back, while a single rooted identity that keeps bending through consistent signed labor is expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
